section: AVI-SPL services for Microsoft Teams with Copilot and Microsoft Places: workshops, implementation support, optimization
body:
This AVI-SPL page promotes an interactive eBook on enabling a smart workplace with Microsoft Teams, and in doing so lists the services AVI-SPL offers enterprises that already use Teams and want to add Microsoft's AI and workplace tools.

**Who it is for**
IT leaders at enterprise organizations who have invested in Microsoft Teams and want more value from it, whether they are rolling out new features or optimizing an existing Teams environment.

**What AVI-SPL offers**
- Help integrating AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Places.
- Strategic guidance and hands-on workshops, with deployment services tailored to the customer's business goals.
- Copilot Readiness and Adoption Workshops: structured planning and customized training for Microsoft 365 Copilot, to get a team AI-ready.
- Microsoft Places Implementation Support: expert-led deployment of Microsoft Places for intelligent space planning and employee experiences.
- End-to-End Microsoft Teams Optimization: covers everything between AV integration and user adoption strategies, so that Teams supports productivity across the enterprise. AVI-SPL integrates Teams Phone, Teams Rooms, Teams Premium, Places and Microsoft 365 Copilot, with the aim of an intelligent, hybrid and secure workplace.

**The eBook**
Titled as a guide to AI and the future of collaboration, it covers how AI is changing Microsoft Teams and how AVI-SPL can help deploy Copilot and Places with a focus on security and compliance. Topics listed:
- how to build a modern workplace with Teams
- Copilot and Places use cases
- strategies for faster adoption and ROI

The eBook is free; a link is emailed after the form on the page is filled out.

**Why AVI-SPL, as the page puts it**
- Trusted by global enterprises, with decades of experience across audiovisual integration, unified communications and Microsoft ecosystem services.
- A global technology provider that designs for current needs and readiness for what comes next, with experience helping organisations attract, engage and retain employees and customers and increase ROI.

**When to use this**
Use it when a customer on Microsoft Teams asks whether AVI-SPL can help with Copilot readiness, Microsoft Places deployment or getting more from Teams Rooms, Teams Phone and Teams Premium.

**Not stated in this source**: licence requirements for Copilot, Places or Teams Premium, prices, or workshop length and format.
